Chaplin - A Great Master of Humour

幽默大师卓别林 · 161 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Chaplin was an extraordinary performer who starred in and directed many outstanding comedies. Few viewers were bored by his little moustache, his gestures or his amusing reactions when detectives chased him. Whether playing a drunk, slipping on a banana skin or whispering about his failures to himself, he made us feel more content with our lives without having to explain anything. His particular sense of humour continues to astonish audiences around the world.

2In a low-budget film, he played a badly-off and homeless person wearing worn-out shoes and messy clothes. In one scene, he was trapped by a snowstorm in a vast mountainous area. Though he overcame many difficulties, his luck still ran out. Once he had eaten all the porridge, he picked out a shoe and boiled it to eat. He cut off the leather sole and chewed it like a pancake. According to an actress, his acting was so convincing and amusing that everybody couldn’t help bursting into laughter.

幽默大师卓别林

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1卓别林是一位出色的表演者，主演并执导过许多优秀喜剧。他的小胡子、各种手势，以及被侦探追赶时的滑稽反应，很少有人会看腻。无论是扮醉汉、踩到香蕉皮滑倒，还是独自低声说起自己的失败，他几乎不用开口解释，就能让我们对自己的生活感到更满足。直到今天，他独特的幽默感仍让全世界的观众惊叹。

2在一部低成本电影里，他扮演一个穷困潦倒、无家可归的人，脚上的鞋磨破了，衣服也乱糟糟的。有一回，他被暴风雪困在广阔的山区。虽然闯过了不少难关，运气还是不够好。粥吃完了，他就挑出一只鞋煮来吃，把皮鞋底切下来，像嚼煎饼一样嚼着。一位女演员说，他演得又逼真又有趣，大家都忍不住放声大笑。
